title: CPSC, JT USA Inc. Announce Recall of Proteus Paint Ball Masks
summary: The plastic facemask could crack around the ear cover, when hit by a paint ball. This could allow the facemask to come off, exposing consumers to eye injuries. Units: About 4,000.

title: CPSC, Atico International USA Inc. Announce Recall of Percolators
summary: If the thermostat fails, the plastic housing of the percolator can overheat and melt while in use, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 198,000.

title: CPSC, Krups Announce Recall of Coffeemakers
summary: An electrical connection in these coffeemakers can overheat and ignite the filter basket support, presenting a risk of fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 218,000.

title: CPSC, Advantage Publishers Group Announce Recall to Replace Educational Kits
summary: The red painted numbers on the acetate stencil sheet included in the "Let's Start™" kit contain lead; and the gold paint bearing the words "Kasy's Extrafine" on the black pen included in the "Optical Illusions" kit has lead. Units: About 160,000.

title: CPSC, DSI Toys, Inc. Announce Recall of Toy Kittens
summary: These toys contain contaminated water that, if contacted, could cause illness to children. Units: About 238,000.

title: CPSC, Imperial Toy Corp. Announce Recall of Toy Feeding Sets
summary: The nipple on the toy baby bottle included in these sets could come off, posing a serious choking hazard to small children. Units: About 100,000.

title: CPSC, Peg Perego USA Announce Recall of High Chairs
summary: When the seat is reclined, the high chairs have a space between the armrest and backrest, in which a child's head or arm can become entrapped. This can pose a risk of suffocation or injury to the heads or arms of young children. Units: About 325,000.

title: CPSC, Raymond Geddes & Co. Inc. Announce Recall of Velcro Wallets
summary: The zipper pull in the wallet contains lead, which can present a risk of lead poisoning to young children. Units: About 55,000.

title: CPSC Announces Recall of Furnaces in California
summary: These furnaces pose a substantial risk of fire. Units: About 30,000.

title: CPSC, Apple Announces Recall of AC Adapter for Prior Generation PowerBook Laptops
summary: These AC adapters could overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 570,000.

title: CPSC, Cans Unlimited, Inc. Announce Recall of Kerosene Heaters/ Cookers
summary: The recalled units are not approved for use indoors. Use indoors can lead to injury and possibly death from carbon monoxide poisoning. The cookers also do not have an automatic extinguishing mechanism that would operate if they turned over, and lack adequate guarding. Units: 2,280.

title: CPSC, Neiman Marcus Announce Recall of Plantation Furniture, Antique Mirror
summary: The furniture could be painted with lead-containing paint. Ingestion of lead from deteriorating paint is a major source of lead poisoning for children 6 years old and under. Units: Approximately 49 items.

title: CPSC, Chicco USA Inc. Announce Recall of Preschool Toys
summary: Some of the larger-sized ball halves can become stuck on a young child's face, covering the nose and mouth, and causing suffocation. Units: About 6,000.

title: CPSC, Hallmark Creations Announce Recall of Tea Light Lamps
summary: The plastic shade that covers the tea light candle can melt, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,300.

title: CPSC, The Flood Co. Announce Recall of Wood Strippers and Cleaners
summary: Some of these bottles can leak at the cap, allowing the contents to come into contact with consumers. These strippers and cleaners can cause burns to the skin and eyes. Units: About 18,000.

title: CPSC, Milwaukee Electric Tool Corp. Announce Recall of Electric Wrenches
summary: The wrenches have power cords that can release from the handle, posing an injury or electrocution hazard to consumers. Units: About 6,000.

title: CPSC, Basic Comfort Inc. Announce Recall of Infant Seat Pads
summary: The seat pad has two shoulder straps that create a v-shaped opening around the head and neck, presenting a strangulation hazard to young children. Units: About 16,000.

title: CPSC, Warn Industries Inc. Announce Recall of ATV Winch Kits
summary: An electrical component of the winch kit, the solenoid, poses a fire hazard when used in this application, even when the vehicle is parked and the winch is not in use. Units: 50,000.

title: CPSC, Inca Imports Announce Recall of Stuffed Bears
summary: The noses, bells, and eyes of the bears can detach, presenting a choking hazard to young children. The eyes also present a sharp point hazard. Units: About 2,600.

title: CPSC, NIKE USA Inc. Announce Recall of Jordan Trunner Cross-Training Shoes
summary: The shoes have a thin metal strip on the outside of the heel that can protrude from the shoe and form a sharp edge that can cut consumers. Units: About 425,000.

title: CPSC, Firms Announce Recall of Hand Trucks, Baby Walkers
summary: If the tires of the hand trucks are substantially over-inflated beyond the recommended maximum 30 P.S.I., the rims of the tire can separate under the intense pressure and strike the user or bystanders. The walkers will fit through a standard doorway and are not designed to stop at the edge of a step

title: CPSC, The Toro Company Announce Recall of Riding Mowers
summary: Spilled fuel can ignite during refueling, when fuel vapors are drawn into the hot muffler. Units: Approximately 39,000.

title: CPSC, Burger King and Alcone Announce Recall of Two Kids Meal Toys
summary: The toys can break, causing small beads or balls to be released, which poses a choking or aspiration hazard to young children. Units: 2.6 million.

title: CPSC, Fisher-Price Announce Recall of Portable Bassinets
summary: Children and adults can be injured when their fingers are pinched or cut between parts of the folding mechanism. Units: About 569,000.

title: CPSC, Safety 1st Announce Recall of Cabinet and Drawer Spring Latches
summary: If the safety latch breaks, a small spring could be released. Young children could choke on the small spring or gain access to a cabinet or drawer where dangerous items are stored. Units: About 1.7 million.

title: CPSC, Acetrike Bicycle Co. Announce Recall of Children's Bicycles
summary: The frames of these bikes can break, causing the riders to fall and suffer injuries. Units: About 38,800.
